message: Bug fixes and refinements on top of v1.58: fixed the Borrowers screen Submit button doing nothing (wrong function calls); removed a leftover duplicate village filter that disagreed with the new Village dropdown; added a With Loan / Without Loan filter on the Borrowers list; added a third 'By Bahi No' lookup path on the Loans screen (pick a loan type, type just the number, it finds that exact loan); added an optional collapsed Date Filter on the Loans screen (Disbursement or Sanction date, from/to, works with or without other filters); Agent-Collected Repayments now open a full review screen on Approve (loan position, pool allocation choice, then the same credited-to popup as every other repayment) instead of posting instantly with no context, and Reject now shows the full loan/borrower/amount details before asking for a reason; the borrower's Credit Rating is now a proper animated semicircular gauge on the Borrower Profile screen (colour and icon change with the score, tapping it opens a plain-English list of exactly which months were paid late and by how many days); renamed 'Download PDF' to 'Download Profile' on the Borrower Profile.
